channel_info.description: Deep-dives into AI, modern software engineering, web architectures, and developer tooling. New technical videos every Tuesday and Friday!

videos.title: Building Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems in 2026: Complete Architecture
videos.description_snippet: A comprehensive deep-dive into how modern LLM agents plan, reason, invoke subagents, and self-heal in complex production environments.

videos.title: SQLite at Scale: Can SQLite Actually Handle Millions of Queries?
videos.description_snippet: Benchmarking WAL mode, PRAGMA optimizations, memory-mapped I/O, and concurrent readers in production SQLite deployments.

videos.title: Multilingual OCR: Transcribing Burmese & English with Multimodal LLMs
videos.description_snippet: We compare traditional Tesseract OCR with Gemini Flash for complex non-Latin scripts like Myanmar (Burmese) and structured JSON outputs.

videos.title: Why Pure Vanilla JS + FastAPI is Still the Fastest Stack to Ship
videos.description_snippet: No node_modules, no webpack configuration, instantaneous reloads. Exploring reactive DOM patterns without heavy framework overhead.

videos.title: 3 Python 3.14 Features You Probably Didn't Notice #shorts
videos.description_snippet: Quick syntax improvements and standard library updates in Python 3.14.

videos.title: Reverse Engineering Telegram Desktop HTML Chat Exports
videos.description_snippet: How to parse joined message blocks, nested reaction initials, and relative media paths into clean JSON schemas.

videos.title: Mastering Pydantic v2: Rust Core Performance & Schema Validation
videos.description_snippet: Deep dive into pydantic-core, custom serializers, field aliases, and schema generation.

videos.title: Executing Dirty MySQL Dumps in In-Memory SQLite Sandboxes
videos.description_snippet: How to sanitize non-standard SQL DDL and DML commands to run portable database analytics anywhere.
